instruction.form: plain clause + と言います / plain clause + でしょう
instruction.meaning: report a message and check a reasonable prediction
instruction.commonContrast: と言います reports words; でしょう expresses an expectation or seeks confirmation

workedExamples.reading: トムさんは あとで 来ると 言いました。
workedExamples.en: An original Yomu context model; use it to notice the target before creating your own response.

guidedPractice.prompt: First find the target in context. Then make a parallel attempt from a cue; the completed response remains hidden until after the attempt.

progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use plain clause + と言います / plain clause + でしょう; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries report a message and check a reasonable prediction.
Compare your form, meaning, and neutral polite reporting with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: と言います reports words; でしょう expresses an expectation or seeks confirmation
retryFeedback.retryPrompt: Revise one part at a time, then try again with your own content.
